name: Trade Coalition
role: Corporate/economic power bloc within the Galactic Union
description: A corporate and economic power bloc operating inside Union politics. Canon establishes three things about it: it was one leg of the alliance that carried Chancellor Zylox to the chancellorship (Trade Coalition + AI Vanguard + economic technocrats, narrowly defeating a military-backed candidate); its headquarters sits on the Union capital, the "Engine of the Union" and wealthiest world; and it brokered neutral ceasefire zones enabling controlled trade between Union, separatist and neutral parties.
political_role: Its backing is a standing constraint on the chancellorship — canon describes Zylox as viewed by Outer Colony leaders as a corporate-controlled figurehead, with corporate-versus-government interests straining as private security expands.
notes: Created 2026-08-09. A named power bloc attested repeatedly in committed canon (chancellorship alliance, capital HQ, ceasefire-zone brokerage) that had no entity record. All attributes recovered from canon; nothing invented.

naming_exemption.reason: "Trade Coalition" preserved verbatim from committed canon.

composition: A bloc of megacorporations, economic leaders and free-market advocates.

instruments_of_power.trade_zone_defense_forces: The TZDF (org_trade_zone_defense_forces) is the OFFICIAL defence unit protecting the Free Trade Zone, and is indirectly under Trade Coalition control — armed force held at one remove from the bloc that directs it.
instruments_of_power.hyperlane_infrastructure: Hyperlane infrastructure projects funded by Coalition partners give it direct control over trade routes.
instruments_of_power.financial_markets: Coalition members control major financial markets through the Union Stock Exchange (org_union_stock_exchange), affecting currency and commodity prices.
instruments_of_power.senate_representation: Many senators are backed by Trade Coalition interests, ensuring policy alignment inside the Union legislature.

governance.note: High Chancellor Zylox Rhaegos sits on the Executive Board, granting him access to economic and corporate leadership OUTSIDE federal control. Canon already records his career as hyperlane development -> Trade Minister (founding the Free Trade Zone project) -> chancellorship via a Trade Coalition alliance; the board seat is the standing institutional form of that relationship, not a separate claim.
governance.bearing: The four instruments above plus a board seat held by the sitting head of government describe a bloc whose leverage runs through, not against, the Union state.

diplomatic_function: Neutral trade leaders serve as intermediaries in negotiations, reaching factions unwilling to engage Union diplomats directly. The Coalition brokered non-combat trade zones, allowing limited economic stability in war-affected regions — an outcome this record already carried as "ceasefire-zone brokerage".

open_identity_question.question: Early prose also names a "Galactic Trade Coalition (GTC)" that "oversees fair trade laws, tariffs, and corporate accountability".
open_identity_question.status: UNRESOLVED — not merged into this record.
open_identity_question.why: That is a REGULATOR's mandate, while everything else attested about the Trade Coalition describes a private power bloc that lobbies, funds and holds board seats. A body that writes tariff law and a bloc that benefits from tariff law are not obviously the same institution, and the shared name root is not evidence that they are — the fragment-match discipline applies to institutions as much as to people.
possible_readings: One body: "Galactic Trade Coalition" is the formal name and the regulatory mandate is its public face.
Two bodies: a Union regulator and a private bloc with confusingly similar names.
Era drift: the name was reused across project phases.

power_structure_source.basis: Recovered from early-project prose. Checked first against canon: this record carried the Coalition's political role and its chancellorship alliance but named none of its institutions. The prose attaches to canon anchors rather than replacing them — Zylox's hyperlane career and his founding of the Free Trade Zone project are already committed canon, and the TZDF protects that same Free Trade Zone.
